note: Emitted by worker/receipts.mjs and worker/pile.mjs from a synthetic scenario. Core output, not endpoint replies: those are under endpoints. Feed frames are shown as replayed (replay: true); live frames carry replay: false.

endpoints.note: What POST /donations/status, POST /donations/history, POST /donations/invoice with accounting: 1, the socket's connect sequence and its live broadcast send, through the real front door and object, for synthetic receipt-mode mappings seeded through the core. Each reply is { status, body }; socket vectors are the messages received at the stated point. Proves the producer's real shapes, cursors, statuses and live/replay framing. Does not prove provider ingestion, D1 projection, reconciliation (health is never current here) or any consumer's parsing. Issuance is off.

projection.note: What an open page's socket hears when the D1 projection publishes lifetime figures, through the real object and the D1 stand-in, after the object's background work has finished: the receipt, tally and board messages from the stated point, and d1, the lifetime tally D1 holds afterwards. A first credit; a restart after a durable batch whose outbox row wasn't removed; a refresh repeated after a stop between sending and noting it sent, which credits nothing; a reversal; and a reconfirmation at the frozen price. Proves the producer's publication order and that every refresh is D1's figure. Does not prove real D1, Durable Object or socket runtime behaviour, provider ingestion, or any consumer's parsing. Issuance is off.

payable.note: The positive payable path through the real front door, object and socket. A complete synthetic snapshot, read through the supported ledger path with destination capability, names a regtest address already bound to the invoice and 6,000 sats left; the private status and history report them while fresh. Past the freshness bound the alarm withdraws both, live, and the replies say so at a newer revision; past the original invoice's expiry Lightning reads expired, and the history keeps the invoice. This world saves a replay bound of 2, so a reconnect from cursor 0 is genuinely too far behind and gets the gap marker. Issuance is off, and no provider has verified the original BOLT11, so Lightning is never available here. Does not prove provider ingestion, real runtime behaviour or any consumer's parsing.
